description: Composes ARIST-MET-998B-BEING-NOT-A-GENUS by calling its theorem, then a reductio on the genus God would be in. The conditional premise 'God's genus would be being' carries Aquinas' reasons (esse = essence, genus signifies the essence) unformalized; it is an open, sourced premise.
